newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil barges jump to $83/$84 on buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil barges jump to $83/$84 on buying.

text.p: NWE fuel oil barges jumped on Friday after one player bought heavily and swaps levels pegged up, traders said.
However cargo markets were lifeless, with most participants on holiday.
A major in the Rotterdam area bought at least 15,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil barges at $83 and $83.50 fob ARA, $1 to $2 higher than Thursday's limited trade.
While some said the buying was a book balancing operation, others speculated it was related to a paper position or a technical problem at a company refinery.
"There is no real reason for the market to go up today," said one trader. Bunker demand was heard to be moderate.
Cargo markets were dormant, with high sulphur buyers relaxed and most promptish low sulphur barrels bought earlier this week after the price dipped. - London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
